item.title: Mailday 0.1.9 · build 10
item.description:
# Mailday 0.1.9 — Settings rebuilt
- Settings follows the approved full reference layout, with the complete category sidebar and compact lists. - Unfinished controls are marked **Not ready** and disabled. They remain planned work. - Accounts opens directly to your mailboxes and Add an account. Account icons stay circular and correctly sized. - Signatures has a shared library, per-account defaults, Most Recent, create/edit/delete and a Mailday tagline option. Existing signatures and draft edits are preserved. HTML formatting is not ready yet. - Theme, app icon, message density, remote images, existing shortcuts, Smart Inbox and utility controls remain available in their new locations.
This development preview supports Apple silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Scheduled delivery still requires Mailday to remain open and online. Hosted account features, most additional reference settings, and cross-device preferences are unfinished. Website icons are decorative and do not verify a sender.
Save any open drafts, then use Mailday → Check for Updates and Restart & update when this version is offered.
